_about: One entry per lesson: exactly what goes into Gemini Notebook. scripts/video/sync_gemini_notebook.py builds gemini-notebook/<slug>/ from this file and regenerates Prompts/<slug>-upload-files.txt. Edit this file, not the generated ones. Sources of truth stay in lessons/, course-assets/, and Prompts/. 'uploads' are copied into upload/ in this order; 'post_only' boards contain faces, are never uploaded, and replace their 'covers' upload variant in the edit.
